deberta	pair	# Linux/WSL (using deploy directory)	**Verification in `obu`.** `obu update` downloads `SHA256SUMS` and `SHA256SUMS.minisig`, verifies the signature against the compiled-in key *before* trusting any line of the manifest, then proceeds as today.
